title: Private funding, spreadsheet sync and smoother motion

items.title: Funding is private
items.body: Funding amounts and donors on Statistics are now visible only to administrators and coordinators.

items.title: Sync from the statistics workbook
items.body: Drop the Excel file on Statistics, choose this month or this year, check every change, then apply. Nothing is ever deleted.

items.title: Top donors
items.body: Who supported the most activities this month, this year or since 2023, by funding or by number of activities.

items.title: Switches that feel real
items.body: On/off settings stretch, overshoot and settle, like a real switch.

items.title: Smoother tabs and lists
items.body: Tab highlights glide to your choice, and a deleted row slides away while the rest move up, so you never lose your place.

items.title: See your password
items.body: An eye button shows what you typed when signing in, and a wrong password gives the card a little shake.

items.title: A sound when something goes wrong
items.body: A wrong password or an action that fails now plays a sound. Turn it off under Sound on errors in the account menu.

items.title: What’s new, right here
items.body: Each update now shows what it brings before you install it. You’ll also find it in the bell and the account menu.

title: Statistics and a new app icon

items.title: Statistics
items.body: Every PHILRADS project and activity since 2023: where, when and who was served, also shown on the Live Map.

items.title: Browse Drive folders in Resources
items.body: Open a shared folder inside the preview, choose files and download them.

items.title: New app icon
items.body: The portal also signs you out after 10 minutes without activity, to keep shared phones safe.

items.title: Chat is coming
items.body: It has a place in the sidebar already, marked Soon.

items.title: Forms
items.body: PHILRADS templates to fill in on screen and print, each on the right paper.

items.title: Projects
items.body: Programs and projects with milestones, reports, team, tasks and documentation.

items.title: Relief events from the portal
items.body: Create relief events on Response and approve them; the IMS confirms them.

items.title: Live Map upgrades
items.body: Temperature over land and sea, full screen, and faster live sharing with a floating bubble.

items.title: Profiles
items.body: A profile card with your level and badges, and photos you can drag and zoom before saving.

items.title: Calendars
items.body: A new look, weekends set apart, and Philippine holidays for 2026 and 2027.

items.title: Team tasks
items.body: See the whole team’s tasks, and mark a task In progress.
